  • Air campaign / targeting Iran: US and Israel are coordinating next steps against Iran’s military-industrial sites. CENTCOM chief met IDF Chief of Staff on further efforts.
  • Pause / diplomacy: Trump announced a SECOND pause on Iran energy strikes (10 days; deadline Apr 6, 2026 8 PM ET), citing an Iranian request. Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating. US reportedly pushing a ceasefire-for-talks option.
  • Regional attacks: Houthis increasing activity — claims and drone launches that reached Israeli airspace. Yemen-origin drones were intercepted by Israel.
  • Domestic security (Israel): IDF shot and neutralized a knife attacker near Dura. Knesset approved Israel’s 2026 budget — largest on record, including large transfers to Haredi institutions.
  • Transport & airspace: Flight-scan shows 540 aircraft in region; airports listed closed: Iran, Iraq, Lebanon. Civil aviation disruptions ongoing.
  • Civilian impact: AP/TASS/Al Jazeera photos and reporting show reduced crowds at Dubai World Cup and slowed trade near Basra. Worker killed in Kuwait reported amid broader regional tensions.
  • US homeland alert: NORAD F-16s intercepted a civilian aircraft near the US President’s residence — shows raised US alert levels and stricter airspace enforcement.
  • Information warfare / media: Multiple state and regional outlets reporting strikes and claims; expect continued asymmetric claims (militias, Houthis) and rapid counterclaims.
  • 🟢 Good News: Israeli air defenses successfully intercepted Yemen-launched drones. IDF prevented a knife attack. Diplomatic channels (Pakistan + US push) are active.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — kinetic strikes and cross-border drone attacks continue; diplomacy active but fragile.

  • מידע ומיסגור קרבות: כלי תקשורת מדינתיים ואזוריים מדווחים על תקיפות וטענות נגדי; צפו בהגברת תביעות אסימטריות של מיליציות והכחשות מהצד האיראני.
  • 🟢 חדשות טובות: מערכות ההגנה הישראליות יירטו רחפנים שייוותרו מתימן. צה"ל מנע פיגוע דקירה. ערוצי דיפלומטיה פעילים.

Active strikes/alerts:

  • Iran is selectively allowing passage for friendly states (Russia, India, China) and blocking others. Commercial shipping and insurance risks remain elevated.

  • Knesset approved the 2026 budget — largest-ever, including large transfers to Haredi institutions.
  • IDF troops shot a knife attacker near Dura. NORAD intercepted an aircraft near the US president's residence — heightened international airspace vigilance.
  • 🟢 Good News: Multiple intercepts succeeded (Yemen‑launched UAVs). Tabriz operator reports no casualties so far. Pakistan mediation effort ongoing.

אוויר / תקיפות

  • נשיא טראמפ הכריז על הפסקת אש שנייה של 10 ימים בעניין תקיפות אנרגיה (מועד סיום 6.4, 20:00 ET), בצירוף טענה על "בקשת ממשלת איראן". איראן מכחישה שיחות ישירות. פקיסטן מתווכת.

פנים ומעטים נוספים
